login.heroTitle: One platform for your entire community needs assessment lifecycle
login.heroSubtitle: From defining community needs to AI-assisted, human-approved reporting — built for nonprofits.
heroBullets: A dedicated, isolated workspace for every organisation
Build surveys from a curated, versioned question bank
AI assists at every step — your team reviews and approves before anything is released
Deterministic scoring rolls up to a prioritized Top-5 needs report
